mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in three months signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and boosts consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% in a month signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals a supply shock, which increases input costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month signals strong labor demand, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 2% each in a month signals robust demand across multiple sectors, which boosts corporate revenues and earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS each increase > 2% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% in a month signals inflationary pressure, which erodes real returns and increases the cost of capital, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% in a quarter signals strong economic growth, which boosts corporate revenues and earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances despite the positive signal.
